env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

logos run .
stdout '^Name=5$'
stdout '^Count=10$'
stdout '^Ok=15$'
stdout '^15 <nil>$'
stdout '^0 bad z$'
stdout '^27$'
stdout '^\[nm ct\]$'
stdout 'a"b\\c'
stdout '^\[g1 g2  \]$'
stdout '^GET$'
stdout '^tags match$'
stdout '^lens match$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt

mkdir $WORK/orig
cp main.lgo $WORK/orig/main.lgo

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go

cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..

cmp main.lgo $WORK/orig/main.lgo

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectcfi

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"reflect"
	"strconv"
)

type Row struct {
	Name  string
	Count int
	Ok    bool
}

func parse(s string) (int, error) {
	n, err := strconv.Atoi(s)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, errors.New("bad " + s)
	}
	return n, nil
}

func total(in string) (int, error) {
	sum := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Row]() {
		n := parse(in)?
		sum += n
		fmt.Println($"{f.Name}={sum}")
	}
	return sum, nil
}

func summed() int {
	s := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Row]() {
		s += []int{1, 2, 3}.map(x => x + f.Index).sum()
	}
	return s
}

type Tagged struct {
	Name  string `json:"nm"`
	Count int    `json:"ct"`
}

func tags() []string {
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Tagged]() {
		out = append(out, f.Tag.Get("json"))
	}
	return out
}

const multiKey = "xml"

type Multi struct {
	Name  string  `json:"nm" xml:"n1" GET:"g1" custom:"a\"b\\c"`
	Age   int64   `json:"age,omitempty" xml:"a2" GET:"g2"`
	Skip  bool    `json:"-"`
	Plain float64
}

func tagKeys() []string {
	const local = "custom"
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Multi]() {
		out = append(out, f.Tag.Get(multiKey))
		out = append(out, f.Tag.Get(local))
		out = append(out, f.Tag.Get("x"+"ml"))
		out = append(out, f.Tag.Get("missing"))
	}
	return out
}

func tagString(tag reflect.StructTag, key string) string {
	return tag.Get(key)
}

func tagOracle() []string {
	const local = "custom"
	var out []string
	t := reflect.TypeOf(Multi{})
	for i := range t.NumField() {
		tag := t.Field(i).Tag
		out = append(out, tagString(tag, multiKey))
		out = append(out, tagString(tag, local))
		out = append(out, tagString(tag, "x"+"ml"))
		out = append(out, tagString(tag, "missing"))
	}
	return out
}

func tagImportedOracle() []string {
	var out []string
	t := reflect.TypeOf(Multi{})
	for i := range t.NumField() {
		out = append(out, tagString(t.Field(i).Tag, http.MethodGet))
	}
	return out
}

func tagImported() []string {
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Multi]() {
		out = append(out, f.Tag.Get(http.MethodGet))
	}
	return out
}

func tagRuntime(key string) []string {
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Multi]() {
		out = append(out, f.Tag.Get(key))
	}
	return out
}

func tagRuntimeOracle(key string) []string {
	var out []string
	t := reflect.TypeOf(Multi{})
	for i := range t.NumField() {
		out = append(out, tagString(t.Field(i).Tag, key))
	}
	return out
}

func foldedTagLens() []int {
	var out []int
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Multi]() {
		out = append(out, len(f.Tag.Get("json")))
	}
	return out
}

func foldedTagLensOracle() []int {
	t := reflect.TypeOf(Multi{})
	var out []int
	for i := range t.NumField() {
		out = append(out, len(t.Field(i).Tag.Get("json")))
	}
	return out
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(total("5"))
	fmt.Println(total("z"))
	fmt.Println(summed())
	fmt.Println(tags())
	fmt.Println(tagKeys())
	fmt.Println(tagImported())
	fmt.Println(http.MethodGet)
	folded := append(tagKeys(), tagImported()...)
	oracle := append(tagOracle(), tagImportedOracle()...)
	if fmt.Sprint(folded) != fmt.Sprint(oracle) {
		panic("tag fold mismatch")
	}
	rt := tagRuntime(string([]byte{'G', 'E', 'T'}))
	ro := tagRuntimeOracle(string([]byte{'G', 'E', 'T'}))
	if fmt.Sprint(rt) != fmt.Sprint(ro) {
		panic("runtime tag mismatch")
	}
	lens := foldedTagLens()
	lenso := foldedTagLensOracle()
	if fmt.Sprint(lens) != fmt.Sprint(lenso) {
		panic("tag lens mismatch")
	}
	fmt.Println("lens match")
	fmt.Println("tags match")
}
